name: OKAYA & CO. INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Okaya & Co. India Pvt Ltd engages in domestic trading, import/export, and installation/logistics support services in India for semiconductor-related products.
summary: Okaya & Co. India Pvt Ltd acts as a distributor and service provider for semiconductor-related products in India, showcasing products from partner companies specializing in high-purity fluid handling, ESD-control materials, and wet electronic chemicals. The company facilitates the import and export of these specialized components and materials, supporting semiconductor manufacturing processes.
